set.body: Implement parcel-level operations on LabeledSurface: fragmented parcel policy ADT (Error, Largest, Each, Merge), geodesic medoid and Euclidean centroid vertex selection, parcel distance matrix (centroid/min), and boundary-contact counts/logicals. Acceptance: tests cover contiguous parcels, fragmented parcels, symmetric distances/contact matrices, and medoid-vs-euclidean divergence fixture. Likely paths: modules/surface/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/surface/parcels, modules/surface/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface.
set.title: Parcel operations over labeled surfaces
